schema.description: HelgoIQ Work Hub tracker board. tracker/items.json is the Hub-first source of truth for the Tracker tab; this file includes a reviewed live Platform mirror. Platform and GitHub Projects imports are never invented.
sourcePriority: platform-live-pull-2026-09-24 (reviewed Platform mirror; preserve platformStatus, launchBlocking, and External→external builder mapping)
direct upsert or reviewed agent PR to tracker/items.json (Hub-first)
TRACKER_EXPORT.json (optional local export; reviewed before publish)
gh issues labeled tracker and/or findings (optional secondary feed)
the seven seeded example rows (retained alongside live rows)

itemFields.id: stable string id (trk-… or issue-N or HIQ-…)
itemFields.title: Platform title / short board title
itemFields.state: open | in-progress | blocked | done | wontfix (derived Hub state)
itemFields.platformStatus: exact Platform status: Not started | In progress | Partially complete | Fixed — awaiting confirmation | Verified by agent (plus Confirmed complete / Wont fix if present); primary Tracker filter
itemFields.launchBlocking: Platform boolean; Tracker badge only, never Dashboard launch readiness or hero %
itemFields.area: Hub area; Platform Backend/Infrastructure/Platform/Admin/Teacher/Client rows map to sensible Hub areas (default ops)
itemFields.builder: claude | codex | cursor | grok | bot-commander | declan | engineering | external | unassigned; Platform owner mapping includes External→external
itemFields.seed: true for the seven retained examples; false for live Platform rows
itemFields.evidence: optional array of {label, url? or note?, kind: drop | github | staging | note}
itemFields.claimedBy: optional builder enum value who claimed the card
itemFields.agentNotes: optional coordination, waitingOn, severity, or evidence note

banner: Sensitive tracker detail is private. Public Hub shows a count of hidden items only until Declan approves a private Hub design. Full cards are not in this public file.
itemsNote: Public scrub 24 Sep 2026: security, tenant isolation, personal data, payment defects, and commercial matters removed from the public board. Aggregates only. Agents: Platform live board or /workspace/private-tracker-backup-2026-09-24/items.full.json until private host approved.
